mechanism: Chloroquine may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism and increase rosuvastatin exposure, while both drugs can accumulate in tissues and increase myopathy/rhabdomyolysis risk.
action: Monitor for signs of statin-induced myopathy (muscle pain, weakness); consider baseline and periodic CK levels; use lowest effective rosuvastatin dose or alternative statin with minimal CYP3A4 interaction.
